title: Luc invoke
summary: One of the fixed English declarations the Runtime gives the Video model. Change these four declarations and docs/luc/agent-protocol.md together.

replaceability.why: These four declarations are the Luc-agent protocol itself: every agent, Lumeri's own or a reviewed stand-in, reaches every Luc through them, and the protocol keeps them the same under a stand-in. A replacement would redefine the protocol rather than implement it, so only Lumeri changes them, together with docs/luc/agent-protocol.md.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, 2026-10-24 (stays Lumeri's, also once the code sandbox exists); docs/luc/agent-protocol.md:40-43

reach.notes: Dispatch can read/write a Project, invoke paid capabilities or wait for interactions only under the chosen Luc's existing grants, editable boundary, delegation and confirmation. No direct external authority is granted by this wrapper.

operations.name: luc_invoke

result.description: Answer owned by the invoked capability interface; see iface:luc.host/v1 for dispatch.

oneOf.description: A declined ToolResult is returned unchanged, with ok false; no package envelope is added.

operations.notes: No wrapper-wide deadline: an interaction may wait for the creator; no model request remains open during that wait. effect paid is the maximum delegated effect because a capability may spend budget, not a charge for dispatch itself. Retrying may repeat writes or paid work; it relies on the chosen capability's idempotency. Delegated errors belong to iface:luc.host/v1 and that capability, not to this wrapper's own code list.

bounds.name: agent_result_chars
bounds.unit: maximum characters of compact JSON or clipped JSON envelope

invariants.text: A model-supplied target selects an existing object; it never grants creator confirmation or additional Host authority.

break: the operation raises unexpectedly or returns an answer outside its declared schema
failure.notes: No replacement seam or run-time interface validator exists for this role today; the class describes who may eventually replace it.

conformance.notes: Existing tests are evidence for the named invariants, not a replacement conformance runner. Only the area contract checker is run in this task.

known_deviations.text: Exceptions from invoked adapters propagate their own codes, or even exception class names through AgentTurn; a closed code list cannot describe all delegated capability failures here.

description.const: Invoke one described Luc capability with its exact input schema. Interactions wait for the creator without making model requests, then return to this same task. For a Project edit, name its existing target kind and id; confirmation is a creator action, never a model argument.
